answers.reason: Japanese has 暗い once and the ledger term already contains 'the dark'; keeping both doubles the adjective.

data.revised_english: The father and mother and child had gathered at the {t:table} under {t:electric-light} hanging against the wall of the narrow room, about to have supper. Father and mother were both still really young. And the child was a chubby, round baby girl, just able to stand holding on to the {t:table}.
data.say: Accepted the doubling fix to keep a single dark.
